scope: Independent read-only implementation/lifetime/order review and retained raw evidence inspection; no workloads, benchmarks, tests, product/dependency edits or commits.
accepted_invariants: The getter checks UoW open state before either returning or constructing memory, caches one original FilesystemMemoryRepository after successful construction, and reuses that same adapter.
Task-only construction, commit, rollback and close do not access the property and therefore do not load, validate, migrate, write or lock unrelated derived memory.

When memory is initialized, session commit remains first, memory commit second and event publication last. A memory persistence failure cannot precede an authoritative task commit through a changed order.

Memory construction still acquires its original source-projection lock, performs original legacy relocation and canonical cache validation, and releases the constructor lock on errors. A failed constructor assignment leaves _memory=None.
Memory mutation still acquires and retains its original project write lock and reloads state after acquiring it; delayed first reads do not bypass conflict/format validation or write synchronization.

Rollback calls initialized memory rollback before session rollback. Close calls initialized memory rollback/close in nested finally blocks, then closes task/session/controller leases even if memory cleanup raises.
Existing public ProjectUnitOfWork protocol already declares a read-only memory property; repository search found no production assignment to this UoW property.
Memory services that access uow.memory still use the original adapter; task/approval/event/snapshot and canonical context paths can now avoid constructing that unused compatibility source projection.
bounded_behavior_changes: Memory snapshot acquisition moves from UoW construction to first memory access. It remains internally coherent but may observe a memory commit made between those points. The project UoW does not promise a globally atomic cross-adapter task-and-memory snapshot.
Task-only operations no longer fail because an unrelated disposable source projection is malformed. First actual memory access still rejects that malformed projection without rewriting it.
Legacy source-artifact relocation is deferred until actual adapter access. This is intentional separation of authoritative task availability from derived-memory maintenance.

FilesystemProjectUnitOfWork remains a transaction object for a single caller/thread. This review does not add support for sharing one UoW concurrently across threads; lazy construction is not independently synchronized.
new_test_review: Actual corrupt source graph fixture verifies task-only get/commit and rollback still work and preserve corrupt bytes, while actual memory graph access rejects invalid content.

Delayed reader UoW is constructed before a writer commits a real snapshot; first reader.memory access sees the commit, then reader acquires its write lease and exit allows a successor to acquire that lease.
Getter access through the closed reader raises RuntimeError; existing mixed task/memory rollback and full UoW controller-lease tests retain broader adapter lifecycle coverage.
